Commentary.Commentary: Joseph was the pick of the WI bowlers while Gabriel was good in patches. They toiled hard on a surface that has started to appear two-paced over the last two hours or so. With a handy lead of 121, Pakistan will hope to make the new ball count as they look to force a result. With just four sessions left, the hosts know that they are the only team who can lose this Test match now. Pressure time for them for sure. Join us in a while for the final session.

That's a fairly good batting performance from Pakistan. The partnership between Azam and Younis set the platform for them with both scoring fifties. Their quick dismissals did jolt the visitors but Misbah and Sarfraz consolidated the position with another fine partnership. The Pakistan skipper will be gutted to be left stranded on 99 but he batted really well. His stand with Sarfraz snuffed out any WI hopes of a fightback.

Abbas takes the review and replays show it was in line and would have gone on to clip the top of leg stump. So, the on-field call stays and Mohammad Abbas has to depart. The Pakistan dressing room is shell-shocked seeing Misbah stranded one short of a deserving ton. PAKISTAN BOWLED OUT FOR 407! Also, TEA TAKEN!

Long extended session lies in Pakistan's court! The visitors have made the hosts toil hard under the hot sun and have given nothing away to them except the wicket of Asad Shafiq. Other than that, Misbah-ul-Haq as always has kept blocking and negotiating it. His slow turtle innings is reaching the 50-run mark and only time will tell when will he pick up pace. Sarfraz at the other end is playing a different innings as he stroked a fifty quickly and looks set now. Pakistan lead by 36 runs at the moment and West Indies need to buck up quickly if they are to restrict Pakistan. A gripping post-lunch session beckons. Join us back shortly.

Fuller on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off, Ahmed taps it towards covers.
Fuller and angling in, Misbah clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Sarfraz Ahmed is the new man in.
Drinks break...

OUT! Shannon Gabriel gets his reward! He's bowling with all his might and finally gets his man! Hits the deck hard, gets a superb amount of bounce and that does Shafiq in. An outside edge is induced which is gobbled by Shane Dowrich with ease behind the stumps. He was beaten by sheer pace there and Shannon is all pumped up.
Fuller delivery outside off, Shafiq leans forward and blocks it out.
A length ball outside off, dabbed towards point.
Short of a length delivery, Asad ducks under the bumper.
50-run stand is up between Misbah and Shafiq!
Short and going down leg, Misbah pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Shafiq taps it in front of covers for scampers through for a quick single.

Misfield! A half-volley outside off, Asad Shafiq leans into it and drives it towards the man at extra cover who fumbles and lets the ball go through. However, he doesn't give up. Goes chasing behind the ball and stops it with his boot. They take three till then.
On a length outside off, Shafiq taps it towards the off side and wanted to get to the other end. But seeing the fielder charging up, Misbah sends him back.
Alzarri pitches it up on off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
Fuller and angling in on middle, Shafiq flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Shortish, angling in, Shafiq defends it near his eye line.
Back of a length delivery outside off, played with an open face towards gully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Kicks off from a good length but the Pakistan skipper adjusts well to block it.
Leg bye! Fuller and sprayed on the pads, Shafiq misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads to fine leg. A leg bye taken.
No ball! Another no ball, second one of the over. Short ball on middle and off, tapped towards covers for a quick single.
Short outside off, Misbah stays back to block it out.

Dropped! Shannon Gabriel is fuming and rightly so. He comes steaming in and hits the deck hard. Extracts a good amount of bounce and it takes Misbah by surprise. The batsman tries to fend it away but ends up gloving it in the air. Vishaul Singh at short leg is a bit late to react, he dives forward but spills it out. He's standing a bit deep and that is why he wasn't able to grab it. A life for Misbah then.
No ball! Short ball down the leg side, Misbah ducks under it. Gabriel oversteps and hence it's called as a no ball.
Touch short on off, defended with a solid front foot push.

FOUR! Edged and through! Joseph sprays it full and wide outside off, Shafiq goes chasing after it. He gets an outside edge towards second slip. The fielder there dives to his right but the ball goes quickly past him to the fence for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
Slips down the leg side, Shafiq tries clipping it but fails to put any bat on it.
Short ball on off, Asad stays back and defends.
FOUR! Exquisite! Fuller outside off, it's a half-volley as Shafiq presses forward and caresses it past the bowler down to long off for a boundary.
Fuller and served outside off, Shafiq defends it off the outer part of the bat towards gully.
Short and angling down leg, Misbah looks to flick but the ball goes off the gloves and evades the keeper. It rolls towards fine leg and the batsmen pick up a couple.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, easy duck for the Pakistan skipper.
Short leg comes in place.
Length ball on middle and leg, again it kicks off one of the cracks. It hits Misbah on the top of his bat and rolls to square leg.
Fuller and drifting on the pads again, Misbah flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase and does well to keep them down to a brace.
On the pads, worked fine down the leg side for one.
Good length delivery, angling in with extra bounce, Misbah comes forward to defend but the ball hits the top of the bat and falls short of the fielder near covers. A single taken.
FOUR LEG BYES! Joseph errs in line and strays on the pads, Shafiq moves inside the line to work it away but the ball brushes his pads and rolls down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Prods forward and pushes it towards covers for nothing.
Shafiq stays behind the line and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Good length ball, angling in with a bit of extra bounce as Shafiq looks to defend but it hits the top of the bat and dies down towards the off side.
Back of a length around off, Misbah taps it towards covers for a brisk single.
Good length delivery outside off, Misbah has nothing to do with it.
Alzarri Joseph has a change of ends!
FOUR! Deft from Asad! On a length around off, Shafiq lunges forward and glides it exactly between point and gully for a boundary. The new ball travels to the fence quickly.
Angles in a very full ball on off, Shafiq keeps it out gently.
On a length around off, defended off the back foot.
Good shot! Fuller again and on the stumps, Misbah comes forward and offers a straight bat push down the ground past mid on. Alzarri Joseph gives it a chase and keeps them down to three.
Fuller in length, outside off, Misbah defends it off the front foot towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Misbah comes forward and drives it straight to the man at gully.
Shannon Gabriel to have a go at it first up.
Second new ball is available and West Indies have taken it straightaway.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and blocks it well.
Fullish and outside off, a bit of inward shape as Shafiq lets it through.
Good length outside off, shaping away a bit as Shafiq lets it pass.
Fuller and outside off, pushed gently to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks well.
Good length closer to off stump, defended well from the crease.
Jason Holder will bowl from the other end!
Fine yorker on the stumps, Misbah digs it out in time.
Length ball wider outside off, Misbah shoulders arms to that one.
On a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
On middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.

It's time to get underway. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. Both the Pakistan overnight batsmen - Misbah-ul-Haq and Asad Shafiq are set to continue from where they left off. Alzarri Joseph to finish his pending over. Let's play...

Hello and a warm welcome for the penultimate day of this Test. Misbah and Shafiq is the current pair and the visitors would be looking to wipe of the trail and then quickly build on the lead. West Indies on the other hand will be feeling confident after the late strikes yesterday. The radar for today suggests that there is some threat of rain and we can only hope it stays away. We will be back with the action soon. Stay with us...
...Day 4, Session 1...

West Indies pacers tried hard throughout the day on a surface that didn't quite have the life in it compared to yesterday although there was some turn. The Caribbean quicks did get some reverse late in the day and with the second new ball around the corner, they would be feeling confident. Crucial first session coming up tomorrow for both sides. Earlier in the day, Amir nipped out the final West Indian wicket quicky to finish with his career-best Test figures. Hope you enjoyed all the action. Join us tomorrow for the fourth day's play. Adios!

A decent final session for West Indies to cap what has been an even day's play. Pakistan rallied through a 131-run stand between Babar Azam and Younis Khan as both stroked fifties. The veteran got to his historic 10000-run mark as well in the process. Just when it seemed like the visitors were running away with the game, Gabriel removed both batsmen off successive overs to bring the hosts back into the game. Shafiq and Misbah managed to avoid further damage but the game is in the balance at present.
The umpires have decided that it's too dark for play to continue. THAT SHALL BE STUMPS ON DAY 3.

NOT OUT! West Indies waste both their reviews! But it doesn't matter as they shall be refreshed after the next 10 balls. Short and going down leg, Misbah looks to flick it on its way and the ball goes flying down to the keeper's left who dives full length to grab it. He immediately starts to appeal for a caught behind but the bowler, Alzarri Joseph isn't interested. However, Holder takes the referral. Replays show it brushed Misbah's thigh pad and there was no involvement of the wood. So the decision stays as it is.
Shane Dowrich takes a flier down the leg side and claims for the catch. The umpire shakes his head and Jason Holder opts for the review against Misbah...
Fuller and angling in from outside off, the Pakistan skipper prods forward to block it out towards covers.
The light meter is out now. It has gone pretty dark out there...
Short ball outside off, Shafiq ducks under it.
Touch short on middle, Shafiq hops across to defend it on the leg side.
No ball! Short of a length delivery outside off, Shafiq stays back foot to keep it out with a straight blade. The umpire stretches his right hand to signal it as a no ball as Holder oversteps.
Keeps it fuller on off, Asad Shafiq presses forward in defense.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, defended down.

FOUR! Chance of a catch! Holder hurls a length delivery, angling down leg. Asad Shafiq moves inside the line to help it on its way but the extra bounce hits his gloves and goes past a diving Dowrich who is a tad too late to react. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary. 200 up for Pakistan, trail by 86 runs!
Misbah walks across and flicks it towards square leg for nothing.
Good length, coming in around off, Misbah is forced to play at it. The skipper opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards gully.
Fuller and getting it to shape away, Misbah comes forward, lifts the bat and lets it through to the keeper.
Length delivery outside off, Misbah leaves it for Dowrich.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked towards Holder at short mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Misbah gets on top of the bounce and dabs it towards gully.
Bumper, angling down leg, Shafiq sits under it.
Short on middle, Misbah hops and manages to tuck it away towards square leg. This time for a comfortable single.

No ball! Good length delivery on middle, Shafiq taps it towards square leg and calls for the single. Misbah runs towards the danger end and the fielder fires a throw at the keeper's end. He misses as the Pakistan skipper dives to get back in. A single taken and it's a no ball as his counterpart overstepped.
Fuller on middle, Shafiq defends it towards mid on.
Fuller on off, Asad gets on the front foot to block it.
Good length delivery on middle, defended towards the leg side.
Sprays it down the leg side, Misbah attempts to flick it away but the ball goes off the pads and rolls down to fine leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Fuller and angling in, a bit of bounce off the deck. Shafiq takes his bottom hand off to defend it on the leg side.
Harmless ball outside off, another leave for Shafiq.
Fuller and it curls back in sharply, very close to the off pole as Asad shoulders his arms after covering the sticks.
Good length delivery outside off, defended solidly off the front foot towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Asad shoulders his arms to that one.
Another inside edge! Fuller and nipping in from around off, Misbah looks to defend but gets an inside edge which runs down to fine leg for a single.
On a length closer to off stump, left alone to the keeper.
Full and outside off, Shafiq presses forward and taps it towards cover.
Good length outside off, Misbah defends it from the crease towards cover.
Gets the inswinger a bit too straight and on leg stump, Misbah glances it down to fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Misbah looks to block and gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Fine yorker around off stump, tailing in, terrific bowling and Misbah does really well to keep that one out.
Length ball outside off, Shafiq dabs it towards gully with an angled bat.
Good length closer to off stump, Shafiq defends firmly from the crease.
Shortish outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a run.

YES THERE WAS! What an absolute waste of a review! Length ball outside off, Misbah tries to block and is struck on the pads. Some noise there as the umpire denies the lbw appeal. WI decide to go for the review. There did seem to be some wood involved but let's see. Replays show there is a clear inside edge there. Not sure why they wanted to review this. Probably because the reviews would be reset in a few overs time.
West Indies have taken an LBW review against Misbah-ul-Haq. Looks like there was an inside edge.
Full and outside off, no shot offered to that one this time.
Beaten! Starts with a nice away swinger, probably some late reverse there for Alzarri as Misbah is beaten on the push.
Alzarri Joseph comes back on.
Good length outside off, gets on the back foot and blocks it to the off side.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed towards the left of mid off for a quick single. The Pakistan captain is finally off the mark.
Good length outside off, Misbah defends it with a straight bat.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Gentle outswinger outside off, Misbah lets it pass to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Misbah plays it with an angled bat towards point.
On a good length just outside off, watchfully left alone by Shafiq.
Very full and around off, squeezed out towards mid on by Asad.
Very full and outside off, Shafiq looks to drive with hard hands. Gets it on the bounce off the bottom edge towards first slip. That's a crowd catch.
Another nice length ball jags in from outside off, Shafiq is trusting the bounce of the surface and letting it pass.
Back of a length around off, jabbed off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
That was close! Nips in sharply from a good length as Shafiq shoulders arms. That wasn't far away from the off pole.
Lovely delivery! On a length and seaming away late after pitching, Misbah hangs his bat at that one and is lucky not to get a nick on it.
Good length angled in around off, stays back to block but gets an inside edge that brushes the thigh pad.
Pitched up wider outside off, leans into it and pushes gently to point. Holder has overstepped again and this time the umpire has spotted it. No ball!
Full and on off, gets across the sticks and pats it to mid on.
Fuller and outside off, lunges into it and blocks to cover.
Back of a length outside off, Misbah throws his hands at it to essay a back foot point. Just short of the man at point.
Fullish length shaping away from outside off, blocked off the front foot towards the off side. Holder had overstepped by a margin there but the umpire didn't spot it.
Jason Holder comes back on for a burst.
Good length just outside off, nips back in a touch as Shafiq shoulders arms.
Dug in short and Shafiq ducks under it with ease. Gabriel has overstepped and it's another big no ball from him.
Back of a length around off, Shafiq rises on his toes and taps it towards gully with soft hands.
Angles in another full ball closer to off stump, left alone.
Fuller this time outside off, Shafiq lets it pass to the keeper.
Fuller and around off, leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
Asad Shafiq strolls out to bat, replacing Babar Azam!

OUT! GABRIEL IS ON FIRE! He's removed both set batsmen in the span of two overs and suddenly, the Windies are breathing life into this contest. Length ball closer to the off stump, no real width but Babar pushes at it with hard hands off the back foot. The ball nips in a touch and he gets a thick inside edge that cannons on to the sticks after brushing the thigh pad. Azam is disappointed but has to walk back to the hut. They check for the no ball but Gabriel is fine. Can the Windies make these double strikes count?
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends well.
Floated outside off, a touch short and spinning away as Misbah pushes it towards cover.
Full and outside off, presses forward and defends it well.
Floated outside off, solidly blocked from the crease.
Drifting in around middle, Babar works it across the line for a single.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
On a length outside off, Misbah lets it pass.
The veteran replaces another as Misbah-ul-Haq walks out to bat next!
Drinks break....

OUT! GONE! Gabriel has the big fish. Lazy shot from Younis though and he has to go. Slower fuller ball outside off, he goes for the drive but fails to keep the shot down. Probably went too hard at it and the ball flies towards cover where Brathwaite takes a comfortable catch. It's unusual of Younis to waste a start and has to walk back. Nice little knock nevertheless and it brings an end to the 131-run stand. It's also Gabriel's 50th Test scalp.
Fuller around off, pushed gently towards mid on.
Back of a length outside off, chops the back foot jab to the off side.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards the off side.
Good length around middle, YK shuffles across and wrists it towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
LOVELY BALL! Finally, Bishoo lands the leg break on a perfect length and gets the ball turn sharply past the outside edge.
Drifting in from outside off, stays back and nudges it towards point.
Floated on a length around middle, gets back and tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Loopy leg break around middle, defended off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Back of a length around off, pats it gently off the back foot towards point.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
On a length outside off, gets on the back foot and taps it towards cover.
Back of a length outside off, gets behind the line and blocks well.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Fuller ball outside off, Babar leans into it and caresses it through the covers. Elegantly struck and timed the pants off that one. Beautiful stuff!
Fullish and on off, leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
Shannon Gabriel is back on.
Fuller outside off, Younis defends it towards cover.
Looped up on middle, defended well off the front foot.
Flighted outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Floated wider outside off, presses forward and smothers it to the ground.
Full and outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks solidly.
Almost a chance! Younis steps out to the flighted delivery but mistimes the lofted stroke. Doesn't carry to the man at mid off.
Drifting in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Flatter around middle, pulled away to the leg side for a single.
Loopy on around middle, defended solidly off the front foot towards the off side.
On a length on leg stump, a bit of extra bounce and Younis works it to the leg side.
FOUR! SHOT! Younis steps out and makes a lot of room to convert this into a full toss. Slaps it to the right of mid off to find the fence. Lovely to watch this man play spin bowling.
Floated around leg stump, blocked solidly off the front foot towards the leg side.
Flatter one on off, Azam is happy to block it away.
Allows the ball to turn in and then Babar offers a straight bat defense.
Floated ball around middle, eased down to long on for one.
Tossed up delivery, Khan stonewalls it right in front of his eyes.
Flat outside off, pats it towards point.
Touch shorter around off, Younis stays rock solid in defense.
Keeps his bat and pad close and defends it down gently.
A nice forward push to this loopy ball from BA.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Steps forward and blocks it out.
Turn and bounce off the rough! Floats it outside leg, Azam stays back to counter it but the ball jumps off the rough and hits Babar on the thigh pad.
Full around middle and leg, Khan makes room and drives it towards mid off for a single.
33rd Test fifty for Younis Khan!

Brings up another milestone! They keep coming for this man, don't they? Raises the bat and no real celebration this time, just sinks all the scanty applause that is on offer. Whadddddaaaaa playeaaaaaaaaa! Around middle and leg, glanced towards square leg and is to the other end quickly.
On a length around middle, nudged around the corner for a single.
Goes deep inside the crease and defends it by crouching low.
Transfers his weight on the front foot and clips it through square leg for another single.
Flatter delivery around middle, tucked through square leg for one.
Short and coming in, Azam waits for the ball to come and then punches it through the gap at covers for a couple.
Leans across and pads it away on the leg side.
Loopy outside leg, defended off the front foot towards covers.
Pitches it around leg, it spins back in as Younis Khan flicks it through square leg and calls for a couple.
A bit short around leg, deflected down to fine leg for a single.
Outside leg, Babar Azam smothers it out on the leg side.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a loopy delivery around leg, it's kept out with a solid tight front foot defense.
Devendra Bishoo is called back into the attack!
Full outside off, Babar Azam looks to drive but ends up dragging it all along the ground towards long on. He will retain strike.
Very full around off, Younis Khan creams the drive towards mid off and gets to the other end in a jiffy.
Flatter around middle, punched off the back foot towards the bowler.
Loopy outside off, defended into the ground.
SIX! Down the track and away she goes! Younis Khan skips down the track and sends it sailing over the long on fence for half a dozen.
Outside off, Khan comes forward to defend but it takes the inner half of the bat towards short leg.
Floated ball around off, Younis once again steps out and bunts it back towards Chase. The bowler fumbles and they sneak a quick single.
Goes back and turns it with the spin to square leg.
100-run stand between Babar Azam and Younis Khan!
FOUR! Good use of the feet! Tossed up delivery outside off, Younis Khan comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drills it past mid off for a boundary.
Allows the ball to come in and then meets it with a straight blade.
Flighted ball outside off, Younis gets across and pushes it with an open face bat past first slip for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Babar Azam prods forward in defense.
Darted around middle and leg, nudged away towards mid-wicket.
Stays back and hits it down to long on for one. 150 up for Pakistan!
Flattish delivery on middle, punched to the right of the bowler.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Slower through the air around off, another front foot defense on offer.
Pushes it quicker through the air outside off.
Touch flatter around off, Babar Azam taps it in front of covers and scampers through for a quick single.
Short and around leg, tucked towards the man at backward square leg.
Floats it up around off, wristed towards mid-wicket.
Comes forward and chisels it towards the off side.
Darts it around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Takes a good stride forward to this loopy ball and keeps it out.
Prods forward and buries it onto the pitch.
Short again but this time there is no room to free the arms. Babar Azam hits it a bit uppishly towards point.
Comes down to the pitch of the delivery and eases it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Flayed! Kraigg bowls it short and outside off, gives room as Younis Khan rocks back and slaps it behind point for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full around off, defended into the ground.
Kraigg Brathwaite is back into the attack!
Tossed up ball, a bit of extra bounce as Azam counters it towards square leg. A maiden from Roston!
Turning in from outside off, Azam goes back to work it away but gets a safe leading edge towards the left of the short leg fielder.
Tad short on off, cut off the outer part towards point.
More flight around off, Babar smothers it with a front foot defense.
Presses forward and stonewalls this full delivery.
Around off, coming in, Azam clips it towards short fine leg.
Length delivery on middle and leg, defended off the back foot towards square leg.
Pitches it up this time, Khan drives it but finds the man at silly mid off.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Younis Khan bends down to let that one sail over him to Dowrich.
Once again hits the deck hard, on the leg stump, the veteran has got no offering for that.
Bangs in a short ball down the leg side, Younis moves inside the line to let it go.
Short ball again on middle and leg, Khan sits under it calmly.
Floated delivery outside off, Azam comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls past first slip. They take a couple.
Azam presses forward and keeps it out.
Full around off, defended by lunging forward.
Flatter one around off, defended off the back foot nicely.
Sliding around leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full around leg, Younis comes forward and wrists it towards the man at short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and down the leg side, this time Azam walks across the sticks and tucks it fine down the leg side for a boundary to end the over.
Another short ball, down the leg side, Azam gets out of it.
Another short ball on leg, Azam has got nothing to do with that one.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Azam ducks to evade it.
Comes from around the wicket and hurls a length ball on off, defended down by covering the line.
Fuller in length and around off, Azam drives it back to the bowler.
Alzarri Joseph will bowl from the other end!
Flatter on middle, leans across and clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Floated around middle, worked with the turn towards the leg side.
3rd Test fifty for Babar Azam!

FOUR! Nice shot! A touch short and outside off, Azam stays back and cuts it very late through backward point to find the fence. It's been a very solid knock this from the young man and he will hope to convert this into a big one.
On middle and leg, worked awy on the leg side for a single.
10000 Test runs for Younis Khan!

FOUR! THERE IT IS! Take a bow, Younis Khan you champion! Brings up the historical milestone and joins an elite bunch there. What a loyal servant of Pakistan cricket this man has been! Reaches the landmark with a fine sweep that beats short fine leg easily as it goes to the fence. He is absolutely elated and does a victory lap towards the boundary line, raising his bat towards the dressing room and then comes back to hug his partner. Well done!
Floated on off, leans across and works it with the turn towards mid-wicket.

Welcome back for the final session of the day. Pakistan will hope to keep the good work going while the Windies will hope that they can break this partnership and then build on it. The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Younis Khan is on strike, just a single away from the magical landmark. History about to be made. Roston Chase will start proceedings after tea.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 3.....

Pakistan's session! Babar Azam and Younis Khan continued to dig around for the entire session and have kept the hosts at bay. The pitch seems to be a good one for batting now and both these batsmen have taken their own sweet time to settle in as they scored just 66 runs in 28 overs. The veteran is just one run short to reach the landmark of scoring 10K Tests runs. History is in the making. Join us back shortly for the final session...
Flatter around middle, a half-pull that is mistimed towards square leg. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 3.
Looped up on a length around off, gets on the back foot and blocks it well.
Fuller around off, leans forward and blocks it towards silly mid on.
Drifting in from outside off, a bit of extra bounce as Azam taps it with soft hands towards first slip on the bounce.
Shortish outside off, Khan rocks back and pushes it towards cover for a single. Moves to 9999 career Test runs.
Full and outside off, Khan presses forward and blocks it on to the track.
Kraigg Brathwaite is introduced into the attack.
Fuller on off, leans into it and blocks firmly down the track.
Loopy and outside off, Azam gets across to flick but is hit on the pads.
Floated outside off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Full and outside off, drills it firmly to mid off.
FOUR! That's a gift and Babar won't miss out. Too short and wide outside off, he pounces on it with a fierce cut through backward point as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
On a length outside off, gets back and pushes it towards cover-point.
Roston Chase comes on to bowl.
Good length closer to off stump, Khan stays in the crease and blocks it well.
Once again the line is down the leg side, Khan misses the flick once more.
Four Byes! Erratic stuff from Gabriel. Sprays it well down the leg side, Khan fails to flick it and the ball beats a diving Dowrich to the fine leg fence.
Shortish outside off, Khan gets back to block but the ball hits him high on the bat as the ball rolls to point. Gabriel has overstepped by a mile there, big no ball.
Another bouncer and once again Khan ducks quickly.
Shortish on middle, YK ducks under the bumper.
On middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Flatter on off, gets back and works it gently towards square leg.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and defends it towards cover.

FOUR! LAUNCHED! Younis has had enough of blocking around and decides to step out to the leggie. Gets to the pitch nicely and lofts it cleanly over mid on for a one bounce boundary. Just two away from the historic landmark.
Flatter on off, sits back and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting in around off, swept away towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Floated on a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Another bouncer, Babar ducks instantly under it.
Shortish but the line is down the leg side, Babar easily sways away from it.
Dug in short by Gabriel and Azam ducks under the bumper.
Very full and drifting down the leg side, Younis clips it gently towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and off, reaches out and defends solidly down the track.
On middle and leg, Younis clips it down the leg side for a couple.
Fuller outside off, Azam pats it towards cover.
Floated outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks well.

THAT WAS FUNNY! Babar was going across the stumps for the premeditated paddle scoop but finds the length and line not apt for it. Too late to withdraw from the shot and he gets into a tangle as the ball whizzes past him, clipping the helmet softly on its way towards first slip.
50-run stand between Azam and Younis.
Drifting in around middle, Younis steps out and takes it on the full by wristing it through wide mid on. Gabriel gives chase and exhibits some awkward football skills to save a run for his side.
A bit quicker this time outside off, another watchful forward block from Khan.
Floated up on off stump, YK gets the big stride forward and smothers it.
Tries a yorker but ends up doling out a full toss on the pads, Babar's flick cannot beat the fielder at mid-wicket.
Pitched up around off, Azam drives it firmly towards mid on.
Full and angled in from outside off, solid front foot defence by Azam.
Fullish and on fourth stump line, seaming in a touch as Babar lets it pass.
Very full and on the pads, Babar works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Good length closer to off stump, stays in the crease and blocks it to cover.
Shannon Gabriel is back.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it to cover.
Drifting in from outside off, reaches out and defends it to cover.
Floated outside off, leans forward and pushes it to cover.
Full toss outside off, dips a bit and Younis can only jam it to mid off.
Loopy and outside off, YK gets forward and pushes it towards cover.
Full and outside off, leans forward and blocks it solidly.
Had to hurry! Fuller on off stump, nips in a bit as Younis drives with hard hands. Squirts an inside edge to mid-wicket as they steal a quick single. 100 comes up for Pakistan.
Good length closer to off stump, solidly defended by Younis.
Dug in short on leg stump, Khan ducks under the bumper.
Shortish outside off, Younis rises on his toes and rides the bounce to tap it on the bounce to gully.
Full and outside off, pushed gently to mid off.
Back of a length on middle and leg, leans across and clips it away down to fine leg for a single.
Drifting in around middle, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, Babar stays in the crease and defends well.
Floated outside off, defended solidly from the crease.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Nervy moment for Babar! Tries to work across the line and is early into the shot. Gets a leading edge that just eludes the man at cover.
Floated around middle, pushed past the bowler towards mid on for a single.
A low full toss outside off, Azam drills it past cover and point for a brace.
Holder serves a short ball outside off, Azam stays back and punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Fuller on off, driven straight to mid off.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Azam taps it off the back foot towards point.
FOUR! Easy pickings those! Drifting on the pads, Babar Azam is quick to latch onto that one. Shuffles a touch and deflects it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Brisk running! Fuller and firing in on middle, Khan flicks it towards wide of mid on and sets off. There is a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A run taken in the end.
Lovely ball! Lures Azam to come forward, the ball pitches around off and then turns away to beat the outside edge.
Around middle and leg, Khan sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Pushes it slower through the air around off, YK presses forward to defend.
Full around off, very full and it's buried into the ground.
Quicker and flatter outside off, turning away, Khan looks to cut but misses.
Around leg, turning in, Younis Khan stonewalls it.
BA lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full around middle, pushed towards mid on.
Pitching outside off, shaping further away, Azam stays away from it.
Too wide outside off, Azam lifts his bat to leave it alone.
Full and too straight on the pads, Younis Khan works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery, outside off, Khan leaves it alone.
Jason Holder is back into the attack!
Flighted ball around off, Babar Azam comes down the track and bunts it straight back down the ground. The bowler fails to stop it and it hits the timber at the other end.
Azam prods forward to this loopy ball and defends.
Quicker and fuller on off, pushed again to point.
Short and flat again, served outside off, cut once again towards the point fielder.
Quicker one outside off, cut towards the man at point.
Tossed up outside off, Younis Khan presses forward to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls past first slip. A single taken.
Drinks time at the Sabina Park!
A shout for an LBW! Good length delivery, angling in on middle, Azam misses the flick and is rapped on the pads. An appeal for LBW has been turned down by the umpire. Maybe, going down leg.
Short and angling in on body, Azam takes his bottom hand off and keeps it out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Nipping back in from a length, Azam defends.

FOUR! Up and over gully! Joseph doles out a short ball outside off, gives enough room as Babar Azam slashes at it. He manages to control the slash and it goes well over a leaping gully fielder for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, defended nicely by covering the sticks.
Flattish outside off, cut towards sweeper cover for a single.

SIX! Boom! Bishoo floats it up around middle, Babar Azam had enough of defense. He gets down on one knee and sends it packing over mid-wicket with a mighty slog sweep. That went right off the meat of the bat.
Loops it up around off, hits one of the rough marks and rises. Azam looks to defend but gets hit high on the bat and then dies down.
Flatter and shorter on middle, pulled towards mid on.
BA has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up around off, defended by lunging forward.
Fuller and pitched on off, Khan pushes it towards the point fielder.
Younis Khan covers the line and leaves it alone.
Fuller outside off, Younis Khan opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards gully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short of a length outside off, Khan shoulders his arms.
Good length delivery on off, defended with a straight bat.

In the air... safe! Bishoo sends in a wrong 'un around off, Younis Khan runs out of patience as he looks to slog sweep this. Gets a top edge which squirts up towards the off side. Much to Younis' delight the ball falls safely in the cover region. A single taken.
Tossed up delivery around middle and off, Khan defends it down safely.
Quicker through the air outside off, Khan winds up for a cut shot but fails to get going with it.
Floated outside off, Younis Khan defends.
Lunges forward and buries it into the ground.
Googly around middle, turned towards square leg.
Short of a length delivery outside off, punched towards extra cover for nothing.
Good length outside off, Azam punches it through covers and takes a double.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot.
Digs in a short ball on off, Azam sits under the bumper.
Fuller and tailing back in a bit, Azam defends it down.
Shortish delivery on middle, defended by hopping across.
Leg break around off, turning away, Khan covers the line to let it be.
Nicely looped up outside off, driven hard but finds the cover fielder.
Tossed up outside off, eased through covers for a single.
Around off, spinning away, Younis leaves it for the keeper.
Gives it a bit more flight outside off, the veteran pushes it with a stride forward towards extra cover.
Tossed up around off, Khan defends it off the front foot gently.
Short of a length ball on off, Babar Azam hops back and defends it down.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Khan clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Similar delivery, this time it's pushed towards mid off.
Fuller on off, driven straight to extra cover.
Full and moving away outside off, Younis lets it be.
The batsman does well to stand tall and play that short delivery.
No ball! Fuller and tailing back in, Khan does well to smother it away. It's called a no ball for overstepping but replays show it wasn't.
Alzarri Jospeh is back into the attack!
Loopy ball around middle, bunted back to the bowler.
Pushed quicker through the air around off, Azam keeps it out off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, Azam lunges forward to defend it down.
Flatter one around middle, Azam stays back in defense.
Loopy leg spinner around middle, turning away, Younis gets back and flicks it through square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Loopy delivery, around middle, Younis lets the ball dip in and then defends it down.
Time for spin then as Devendra Bishoo is brought into the attack! A slip in place for him.
Fuller on the stumps, defended towards covers.
Back of a length outside off, Azam leaves it alone.
Fuller and on middle and leg, Babar gets across and flicks it straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Keeps it wide outside off, a pat from Azam towards covers.
Shortish outside off, Azam stands tall and punches it towards covers.
Goes wide of the crease and spears in a full ball, angling in, Azam is rock solid in defense.
Drifting on the pads, Azam clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish delivery on middle, defended with a straight bat by Babar.
Angling in from around off, Azam leans across and blocks it.
Leg bye! Sprays once again down the leg side, YK shuffles to flick but the ball brushes his pads and rolls towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Almost a yorker on middle, Younis Khan jams it out.
Good length, angling in, defended down the pitch.
Outside off, left alone.

A shout for a caught behind! Gabriel sprays it down the leg side, Azam tries glancing it on its way and it goes towards the keeper who dives to his left to take it. They appeal but umpire Kettleborough shakes his head. Replays show it went off the pads.
Azam stays on the back foot and punches it towards the off side.
Fuller in length and angling in, Azam looks to drive it but gets it off the inner half as the ball rolls towards mid on.
Leg bye! Fuller and angling down leg, Younis misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Good length delivery outside off, Khan stays back and defends.
Shortish delivery, Azam is forced to duck under it.
Fuller outside off, Azam leans forward and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Shortish outside off, gets on the back foot and blocks it towards cover.
Another full ball around off, Babar gets forward nicely and pats it to mid off.
Fullish ball attacking the stumps, Azam shuffles a touch and bunts it towards mid on.
Back of a length closer to off stump, Azam rises on his toes to block firmly.
Full and outside off, Younis shuffles a bit and blocks to cover.
Back of a length outside off, Azam punches it in the gap at cover as they take a single. Gabriel has overstepped by a big margin and that's a no ball.
Shortish outside off, Azam hangs back and punches it towards cover.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly.
Full and outside off, Azam drives it nicely past cover for a couple.
Shortish outside off, Azam hangs back and blocks it solidly.
Good length outside off, Azam hangs back and stabs it to the off side.
Back of a length outside off, Younis hangs back and blocks it towards point.
On middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket for a single.

DROPPED! Sharp chance but you need to grab those to nose ahead in international games. Holder tries the yorker but ends up giving a full toss, Babar pushes it firmly back at the bowler who gets his left hand in the followthrough but it doesn't stick. Tried to take it on the rebound but couldn't get a hand on it. Huge reprieve for Azam.
On a good length and seaming away, the line is too wide and this time Azam doesn't play at it.
LOOSE FROM BABAR! Short of a length outside off, a bit of width and Azam chases it with a flashy cut. No footwork at all and he is lucky not to get a nick as the ball moves away a bit.
Fullish ball outside off, Azam pushes it towards mid off.

Welcome back for the second session. Pakistan's experienced middle order will be tested for sure. Will the veterans stand up or can WI make inroads? We shall find out as the players and umpires take the field. Jason Holder to begin proceedings after lunch.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 2.....

West Indies will be happy with the session. Their last wicket didn't add too many this morning but the pacers have given them something to smile. Azhar Ali fell to a poor shot while Ahmed Shehzad was undone by a beautiful indipper from Jason Holder. The bowling hasn't been great from the hosts but they were more accurate in the second hour of play as they used the conditions comparatively better. Pakistan need a partnership to weather this early trouble. Younis is in and Misbah still to follow. Join us in a short while for the second session to see how things pan out.
Wayward delivery! Gabriel sprays it miles down the leg side, Younis Khan has got nothing to do with that one. LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Fuller and wide outside off, Younis will never go after it.
Fuller outside off, Younis Khan looks to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards mid on.
YK defends it from within the crease.
Once again shorter in length on middle, kicking off the deck as Younis ducks under it.
Short and angling down leg, Khan ducks to evade it.
Good length delivery, curling back in with some bounce. Azam is undone by it and is hit on the thigh pad.
Fuller around off, Azam defends it down gently.
Short of a good length delivery on off, punched off the back foot towards mid off.

FOUR! Beautifully done! A half-volley on off, Babar Azam leans into it and unfruls a glorious drive through extra cover for a boundary. The mid off fielder gives it a chase but the ball was always winning the race.
Slants it on the pads, clipped towards square leg.
Short and angling down leg, A bit of extra bounce and Azam is happy to sit under it.
Very full on the stumps, Younis jams it out towards mid off.
Good length outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Almost chopped on! A length delivery, angling in from around off, Babar Azam brings his bat down in time to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and bounces over the stumps.
Touch fuller outside off, Babar lunges forward and keeps it out on the off side.
Another full ball outside off, Babar brings his bat and pad close to defend it towards covers.
Fuller in length around off, defended off the front foot.
Hits the deck hard, YK ducks to evade it/
Comes back in with a angle, Khan defends it down.
Full and down the leg side, Younis misses his flick and it goes towards the keeper.
The veteran, Younis Khan walks out to bat next, replacing Shehzad!

OUT! That's dead plumb! Holder is all smiles with his hands aloft! Pitches it on a length outside off and it nips back in sharply to ping Shehzad on the back pad who is late to bring his bat down on time. A loud shout for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger much to Holder's delight. Shehzad doesn't review and starts to trudge back.
Fuller and on the pads, Shehzad clips it through mid-wicket and picks up a comfortable double.
Short of a length ball, angling in, Shehzad stays back and tucks it towards the leg side.
Shortish around off, solidly defended off the back foot.
Short of a length outside off, Babar stays back and defends well.
Shortish outside off, Babar hangs back and blocks well.
FOUR! Runs for Azam! Back of a length outside off, Babar glides it through the gully region for a boundary to third man. Played it with very soft hands and steered it well.
Shortish outside off, Azam gets back and blocks it solidly.
Back of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Shannon Gabriel is back.
FOUR! Shortish delivery on middle, comes up at a nice height. Shehzad pulls it with authority through mid-wicket and picks up another boundary. Clearly the short ball ploy not working for the hosts.
Angling in from outside off, Shehzad leaves it alone.
Outside off, Ahmed doesn't look at it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Brilliant! Holder overpitches it on middle, Shehzad leans forward and caresses it with a straight bat down the ground for a boundary. Superbly timed that!
Short on off, punched towards point for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Back of a length ball on middle, Shehzad swivels a touch and pulls it firmly in front of square to pick up a boundary. This time the ball races away to the fence.
No ball! Short and outside off, Shehzad doesn't look at it. Jospeh oversteps and hence it's called a no ball.
Length delivery outside off, Shehzad punches it past covers for a couple.
Very full, coming in, it's blokced down.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Shehzad pulls it over mid on. Not good timing there but still gets two.
Good length delivery, angling in, Shehzad turns it towards square leg.
Fuller outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Full and moving away outside off, Azam shoulders his arms.
Very full on off, squeezed out towards point.
On middle and off, defended down gently.
A shout for an LBW! Angling in on middle and leg, Azam looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal but nothing from the umpire. Might be going down leg.
Shortish and rising off the deck, Azam gets on the top of the bounce and taps it down.
Short and angling down leg, Azam simply ducks under it.
Fuller in length and it shapes away a touch, Ahmed lifts his bat to let it be.
Fuller in length and outside off, Shehzad drives it straight to the man at point.
On a length around off, Shehzad hops a bit and punches it towards covers.
Good length delivery outside off, easy leave for AS.
Sprays down the leg side, Ahmed shoulders his arms.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Shehzad swivels a bit and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
Jason once again gets it to curl back in, Azam offers a solid defense this time.
Good length, jagging in sharply from outside off, Azam manages to leave it alone.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, angling in, Babar takes the evasive action as he ducks under it quickly.
Sprays on the pads, easy for Pakistan opener as he flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Nipping back in from a length outside off, Shehzad defends it into the ground.
Good length delivery around off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Joseph hits the deck hard, Azam crouches low to let it sail over him to Dowrich.
Alzarri fires in a yorker on middle, Azam jams it out towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, Azam drives it nicely but finds the man at point.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Babar ducks under it.
Angling in on middle and leg this time, Azam defends it in front of short leg.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam defends it off the front foot towards covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Shehzad taps it away towards the off side and looks for a single but is rightly sent back.
In the corridor outside off, Ahmed leaves it alone.
Stays behind the line and taps it towards point.

What was that! Shortish outside off, Shehzad is in two minds on what to do. He initially looks to play at it but then decides to shoulder his arms. The ball keeps coming in with the angle and he ends up getting a bottom edge which goes on the bounce towards the slip cordon.
Angling in from a length outside off, Shehzad defends it off the back foot.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, Azam defends it towards the on side.
Good length, swinging away, Azam looks to defend but is squared up a bit and gets an outside edge which dies down.

Azam is off the mark! A length delivery outside off, Babar stays back and punches it through covers. He thought he'll get a boundary but the ball slows down due to the wet outfield and hence will get only a couple.

Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed towards Holder at gully. Shehzad was outside his crease and so the WI skipper has a shy at the striker's end. It hits and deflects further which allows them to cross.
Beaten! Short and outside off, gives width to tempt the batsman. Shehzad looks to slash it through the line but is beaten once again due to the extra bounce.
Change of gloves for Shehzad!
Short of a length delivery, angling in, Shehzad misses his tuck and is hit on the rib-cage as the ball bounces a bit more.
Fuller and closer to off stump, blocked solidly off the front foot to cover.
On a length outside off, Azam shoulders arms to that one.
Shortish outside off, Babar lets it pass to the keeper.
Good length angling in from outside off, probing stuff from Holder and it's a good leave by Azam.
On a length outside off, Shehzad taps it towards cover-point for a brisk single.
Back of a length just outside off, pushed off the back foot towards short cover.
Jason Holder comes on to bowl.
Good length closer to off stump, Azam makes a careful leave.
On a length well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Babar Azam is the new man in, replacing Azhar!

OUT! POOR FROM ALI! A nothing shot and he has thrown his wicket away. This was a touch short and wide outside off, a bit of shape away with extra bounce and Ali flashes his blade at it. The bounce does him in and he gets a thickish edge that is taken well by Dowrich diving to his right. Azhar walks back dejected. Just the start West Indies would have wanted although they probably didn't expect it off such a delivery.
Sprays it well down the leg side, no shot offered as Dowrich dives to his left to make the stop.
Back of a length outside off, Azhar doesn't offer a stroke to that one.
Nice bouncer from Joseph and Ali ducks under it.
Fuller ball outside off, Ali leans forward and creams it through extra cover. Bishoo from mid off gives chase and puts in a desperate slide to save a run for his side.
Low full toss on the sticks, pushed towards mid on.
Good length angled in from outside off, Ali leaves it alone.
Shortish outside off, Ali camps on the back foot and blocks it to cover.

FOUR! PURE CLASS! Overpitched from Gabriel and Ali unleashes a beautiful drive past mid on for a boundary. Struck it with a very straight bat and sublime timing. Both openers playing delightful strokes.
Fine yorker on the stumps, Ali does well to dig it out.
Pitched up closer to off stump, nice shape for Alzarri here as Shehzad leaves it alone.
Wide outswinger outside off, Shehzad doesn't need to play at those.
Good length around off, nips in sharply, Shehzad stays back and works it with the inward movement to mid-wicket.
Shocker from Joseph as he sprays this well down the leg side, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller and outside off, pushed gently towards cover for a single.
On a length around middle, Ali tucks it behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Shehzad makes an easy leave to that one.
Fuller and on fourth stump line, Shehzad watchfully lets it pass.
Fuller ball around off, Shehzad gets half-forward and pats it to cover.
FOUR! FAB SHOT! Back of a length outside off, hint of width and once again Shehzad doesn't try to overhit the ball. Just uses the bowler's pace and punches it behind point for a boundary.
Good length around off, nips in a bit as Shehzad blocks it around his front pad.
FOUR! Nicely struck! Very full and outside off, Shehzad gets forward and eases it down the ground past mid off. Just a gentle push but the timing was really good and fetches him a boundary.
Fullish and outside off, swinging away, the wider line allows Ali to make the leave with ease.
Keeps probing away in the corridor of uncertainty, Ali is tight in his defence.
Good length outside off, Azhar stays back and blocks towards cover.
Length ball on off stump, blocked firmly with the full face of the bat.
Shorter length this time outside off, a hint of shape away, Ali lets it pass.
FOUR! SHOT! Joseph starts with an overpitched delivery outside off, easy pickings for Ali who strokes an elegant cover drive through the big gap on the off side. Speeds away to the ropes.
Alzarri Joseph to share the new ball.
On a length outside off, Shehzad hangs back and blocks it solidly towards cover.
Good length outside off, Shehzad rises on his toes and blocks it towards cover.
Fuller and slanting into the right-hander, Shehzad pushes it down the track to the bowler.
Length ball wider outside off, that's a comfortable leave for Shehzad.
Good length closer to off stump, Shehzad pushes at it with soft hands. Gets a soft edge that goes to the right of the gully fielder.
On a length closer to off stump, Ali pushes tentatively at it and gets the ball off the inner half behind short leg for a single.
